messages:
oliver: Heads-up — console showing v2 'recommended' badge while traffic is 100% v1 for /generate on acme-payments. Screenshot uploaded.

sujata: Tenant id, thanks.

oliver: acme-payments.

aj: Probably a telemetry join problem; console reads config cache and metrics separately.

maria: Badge logic prefers preferredVariant from cache. We should avoid giving customers mixed signals.

linda: Router emits X-Variant=v2-beta. Ingestion maps unknown suffixes to 'other' so metrics don't match.

oliver: Proposal: show active badge from recent serving metrics (>1% last 5m) else show preferred. Tooltip to explain.

sujata: Short-term tooltip OK. Long-term: metrics should determine 'active' label, config shown as 'preferred'.

aj: UI idea: show both with a confidence indicator (green/amber/red) — avoids blocking render.

kevin: Router-counter reads cheaper than full TSDB; need QPS estimate.

linda: I'll normalize variant suffixes on ingest (v2-*, v2beta -> v2) to reduce false mismatches.

maria: Plan: 1) confidence UI + clearer 'Pinned to vX' copy 2) router-counter for initial badge 3) tooltip with last-5m % 4) background TSDB reconcile.

aj: Est: prototype 2w, QA+rollout 1w, flag rollout 1w. Feature flag: console.variant_confidence_ui.

deploy-bot: deploy triggered: console/ui-service v2.14.7 -> canary. sha: ab12cde.

deploy-bot: canary completed on console-canary-3.

maria: Action items: UI/messaging (maria), ingest mapping (linda), router endpoint + debug banner (aj), QPS cap check (kevin), PM ticket for dashboard tile (sujata).

oliver: thanks — ping if blocked. :thumbsup: 

linda: I'll baseline mismatch metric and report tomorrow morning.
